note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI declares a 28% charge that costs 5.4 overwatch damage on a unit with 11 wounds. The charge gives only about 3.4 expected damage, so the net result is negative. Fix: Score each charge as P(success) x (damage + trade value) minus overwatch loss minus the loss of objective presence. Always include a 'no charge' option scored at zero. Reject charges below about 40% unless the net score is clearly positive.
suggestion: Beast Snagga Boyz declares charge against Stormboyz (28% chance, 8.9" away, expected 12.0 melee dmg vs 22 HP, overwatch risk: 5.4 dmg)
